sections.title: Who I am
sections.body: I'm a product designer in Hyderabad. I trained as a chemical engineer and worked at Tata Consulting Engineers before moving into design. I taught myself the rest through a mentor, courses and a lot of reading, and my first design role was at Univ.AI. In 2025 I completed the NextLeap PM Fellowship, which sharpened how I think about problems, metrics and prioritisation.

sections.title: How I work
sections.body: I start with the problem and the person who has it. I question long feature lists. I like seeing how a decision moves through a whole system, not just one screen.

sections.title: What I care about
sections.body: Products built for the long term and improved with real users, where I can see whether a decision worked.

sections.title: What I'd cut
sections.body: Features nobody asked for, documents nobody reads, and metrics nobody can act on.

sections.title: Get in touch
sections.body: I'm looking for a product team where design and product thinking go hand in hand.
